title: A zoomable timeline of 4M Wikipedia events
claim: Show HN: A zoomable timeline of 4M Wikipedia events
why_good: A zoomable timeline of 4M Wikipedia events — a gorgeous data-viz that makes history explorable, with strong shareable appeal.
value: Hard to monetize directly; possible edu licensing or premium embeds, but it's closer to a showcase than a product.
risk: Beautiful but a viz/showcase; Wikipedia data is free and the audience rarely pays for browsing history.
